DevOps is the tool we use to manage all the bugs received from the portal. It is everyone's responsibility to document a bug well.

<h1>Two things matter when documenting a bug:</h1>

<h2>Tagging</h2>
Each bug should be tagged using one of the following tags:
- Bug Type : Platform related
- Bug Type : Wrong expectations
